name: Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest, 05R/23L, is 3,800 m long and 60 m wide

handling.v: hangar space for visiting aircraft by arrangement with operating airlines; no handling agents named

noise.v: no engine tests from 00:00 to 06:00 local time (1600-2200 UTC) unless authorised

permits.v: private flights need a permit from the CAA, applied for like non-scheduled flights: file with the CAA 2 working days before entry or exit; foreign passenger or cargo charters file at least 10 working days before departure and may not fly before CAA approval; ETA/EOBT notice 48 hours ahead for customs, immigration and health (AIP GEN 1.2, 2023 edition, newest found)
permits.quote: must obtain a permit from the CAA

missing: iata (AIP page does not state it)
curfew (none stated; AIP does not say there is none)
